propositions: The prelude call to show_ticket executes outside the try-except block that catches LLMError and builds failure_diagnostic, causing prelude failures to escape recovery without diagnostic context.
When show_ticket raises RebarError due to missing ticket id or store reduction failure, the primary run's computed budget and repetition diagnostic is lost and not included in the final error.
Moving show_ticket inside the existing try-except so prelude failures land in the preflight stage will preserve and prefix the primary diagnostic via the existing error handling path.
The gate-error sidecar must be emitted when RebarError occurs during recovery prelude execution.
